title: Roles & Permissions
description: Manage roles and their permissions. System roles cannot be deleted and their permission set is read-only — duplicate one as a custom role to change it.
noRolesDescription: Create a custom role to get started.

detail.systemReadOnly: This is a system role — its permission set is read-only. Use "Duplicate as custom role" to get an editable copy with the same permissions.
detail.duplicateDescription: Creates a custom role with the same permissions as "{{name}}". The copy is fully editable.
detail.permissionsDescription: Check the permissions this role should have. Changes take effect on the user's next session refresh.

actionGroups.readDescription: See this resource and its contents.
actionGroups.writeDescription: Create and change this resource, including every action that modifies it.

createModal.title: Create Role
createModal.description: Define a name and optional description for the new role. You can configure permissions after creation.

deleteDialog.title: Delete Role
deleteDialog.description: Are you sure you want to delete the role "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.

messages.duplicateSuccess: Custom role created with the same permissions
messages.duplicatePartial: Role created, but its permissions could not be copied. Set them on the new role.
messages.roleHasUsers: Cannot delete a role that has assigned users
